note: GTA 6 updates, newest first. Versions use the PS5 form (01.002.002). `notes` = what Rockstar's notes list, in our words. `status`: Reported unless read on Rockstar's own page. `src` is our record only and is never shown.

items.rollout: In stages through the day, so not everyone gets it at once. On PS5 it went out in waves over about six hours.

notes.d: Several causes of the game crashing are fixed.
Some calls didn't trigger, among them the ones that move the story on or unlock new missions.
The game sometimes didn't autosave when it should have.
In some cases a wanted level couldn't be shaken off at all.
Your partner sometimes didn't hand over a bag you meant to sell at a fence.
The deadlift bar at the gym sometimes couldn't be used.
The weather could stay the same for a long stretch.
